body:
OMG the PIANO!! she's doing a medley of "I Knew It, I Knew You," "august," and "All Too Well" at the Grammy Museum — on this piano painted head to toe in flowers. i'm not okay 🎹

longlivets.com/?era=folklore&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=track-fact
why: Founder-directed reactive post (Joey, 2026-08-25), not a calendar slot. New Vault video: Taylor's own official YouTube channel (verified checkmark, 63.3M subs) uploaded a live medley of "I Knew It, I Knew You" (her Toy Story 5 single, no album era), "august" (folklore), and "All Too Well" (Red) for The Recording Academy Songwriters & Composers Wing 20-Year Retrospective at the Grammy Museum. Added to the Videos rail as supabase/seed/videos/folklore.mjs#icon-sessions-grammy-museum-medley (PR #3278, merged 2026-08-25T13:37:47Z), filed under folklore per the 2021 Grammys-medley precedent since 'august' is folklore's own song. Song titles and venue verified against PR #3278's actual merged diff. Link: videos have no dedicated /?item= deep link (getContentItem only indexes the content vault, not VIDEOS_RAW/videosForEra) so this points to /?era=folklore, where the new video surfaces in the Videos rail — matches the posted precedent for video/era-only content (e.g. social/posted/2026-08-13-lover-cruel-summer-x.json's /?era=lover). Media is Joey's own screenshot of the performance (social/joey/Screenshot 2026-08-25 063122.png, 521KB, in range with other library assets) — mediaKind is deliberately "site-screen", not "photo": it's a video screengrab, not sourced from the vault's credited photo corpus, and check-drafts.mjs hard-fails a site-screen tile placed under /social/library/photos/ (that path is reserved for credited Taylor photographs only) — copied to /social/library/ directly instead. Caption note: the source draft phrase "the Eras Tour piano, the floral one" was NOT used — I could visually confirm from Joey's screenshot that the piano is real and painted with flowers, but found no source (PR #3278's diff, the video record, or a live web check) confirming this is literally the same piano used on the Eras Tour, so that specific identity claim was dropped per the absolute-sourcing rule; the caption instead describes only what's visually confirmed. Register per docs/marketing/social-strategy.md's 2026-08-25 update: fan-gush, feeling first, one real detail. X-only for now (per task scope) — no Instagram sibling drafted this round.
